new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..fa723a7819adbe64e26e75903e3bc3d78d395501
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/upload_scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+"""Classify handler lines that serve untrusted upload content."""
+
+TRIGGER_TOKENS = ("upload", "file", "attachment")
+
+
+def is_upload_handler(line):
+    """True when the line handles uploaded files."""
+    lowered = line.lower()
+    return any(token in lowered for token in TRIGGER_TOKENS)
diff --git a/tests/test_upload_scan.py b/tests/test_upload_scan.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f14f5667279713017ebd97d7289a1bc88e4ecf44
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_upload_scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+from src.upload_scan import is_upload_handler
+
+
+def test_upload_handler_is_detected():
+    assert is_upload_handler("def upload_attachment_handler(file_storage):")
+
+
+def test_plain_handler_is_not_detected():
+    assert not is_upload_handler("def health_check():")
